QUOTE: "the gap is larger than two standard errors" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: Only the treatment PGR has a reported SE (0.11); no baseline SE exists, so the difference's uncertainty cannot be computed this way.
QUOTE: "PGR 0.48 (se 0.11)" METRIC: num_seeds ISSUE: Fails to disclose that this is from only 3 seeds, which makes the SE estimate itself highly unreliable.
